concerns.text: T017 (Integration test) depends on T014 (Raw data saved), but T014 is marked [ ] (unimplemented) while T017 is marked [X] (complete). A test cannot exist before its required artifact (raw_dataset.csv) is produced. This violates the 'Producer before Consumer' rule.

T042 (End-to-end integration test) is marked [X] but depends on T048 (Report generation) and T050 (Feasibility check), which are marked [ ]. The E2E test cannot pass before the pipeline produces the final report.

If T029b is not implemented, T029a cannot proceed with the 'if applicable' logic, creating a circular or blocking dependency for the permutation task.

T051 is a revision task to fix T010, but T010 is already marked [ ] (unimplemented). Revision tasks should target existing tasks that need refinement, not unimplemented ones. The ordering of 'fix' before 'implement' is semantically inverted here.
